hypothesis: In the temperature range bar and hourly scrub slider, calculating (temp - min) / (max - min) without a strictly bounded non-zero denominator will yield NaN% or Infinity% when all hourly temperatures are identical (max === min), injecting invalid CSS inline styles and corrupting the layout.

Unsanitized resolvedLocation.name or advice strings injected into the DOM could execute arbitrary JavaScript if a malicious trip title or POI name containing is passed from external API or URL parameters.

Switching day without keyed unmounting or cache cancellation will cause WeatherPanel to render stale previous-day weather metrics under the new day's label, exposing inconsistent local time or wrong weather conditions during SWR revalidation.
